name: Kirkland Signature Wild Alaska Pink Salmon (Canned in Water)
whyItWorks: Cooked right in the can with water and salt, the tender salmon flakes are rich in anti-inflammatory omega-3 fats. Pressure-cooking softens tiny calcium-rich bones so they dissolve effortlessly without roughage.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Drain and flake with a fork. Mix with a dab of light mayonnaise and spread onto white toast or stir into warm rice.
